title: Nushell
comment: A SEPARATE recipe — proves the multi-recipe scan. The engine loads every recipes/*.json and merges their steps. default.json holds the strict minimum to run Claude; this file adds an extra that is generic but not required. An integrator (e.g. a corporate network) later drops its OWN file here the same way — same mechanism, different content.
